result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main defect found is a spelling error in the search bar placeholder text. No significant layout or styling breakages were detected beyond the allowed scrollable/viewport clipping behaviors.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The white heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image sits directly on the photo without a background scrim, and could have poor contrast on lighter images (the pizza card below uses a dark circular background, so the treatment is inconsistent).
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent semi-transparent dark circular background behind all favorite icons to ensure visibility across varying image brightness.
